Canonical product names: owner/office only, reason mandatory, blank unrepresentable, no direct column write, every rename audited, and the switched read models render the approved name only once one exists

Platform capabilities narrow operator authority: a tenant reads none of it, an operator without customer.view reads nothing, and the customer list filters, pages and counts activity without counting the console itself
The internal customer record is unreachable from a tenant, notes are append-only, the platform timeline cannot be edited, and a suspended customer still takes an operator note

One resolution rule for entitlements: an override beats the plan, a limit nobody stated is unknown rather than infinite, a tenant reads its own plan and no other, and the money commands demand a capability, a reason and a fresh password
The document limit counts one unit of work once, refuses before any row is written, treats a limit nobody stated as a refusal rather than as infinity, and never hides what the customer already has

Activation is derived from the audit ledger rather than accumulated, an operator note never overrules a product event that actually happened, an unmeasurable milestone says so instead of reading as not-done, and health returns the reasons that produced it with no score and no prediction

A billing event is attributed only through a link we wrote ourselves and never from its payload, a replay is a no-op, an unattributable event dead-letters instead of guessing an owner, the quota crossing is recorded once per period on the write that exhausts it, and the funnel names the three stages it cannot see

The anonymous signup door is bounded by a limit the database counts rather than a function remembers, stores hashes and never a readable address or email, records refusals as well as acceptances, and is unreachable from any browser role

A conversation belongs to the person who had it: the owner reads cost and health but never text, an unstated assistant quota refuses rather than allows, the hourly rate limit is counted in the database, the confirmed-actions switch is a reasoned policy and not a flag, and deletion and retention remove dialogue while the audit ledger does not move

The business summary has one definition rather than two: the read model re-derives each of the five metrics against independently written queries, a metric that fails comes back unmeasured while its four neighbours keep their exact values, and a second tenant sees only its own numbers

Assistant and supplier email reserve under the same service-only, active-tenant, TTL-bounded, idempotent fencing as the seven original egress kinds, with no expiry carve-out and a boundary closed to a tenth value
Supplier order portal: hashed one-order tokens, immutable structured proposals, reasoned decisions, revisions that never mutate history, and zero browser or cross-tenant surface

Email order delivery: fail-closed communication preferences, the claim/settle ledger with attempt ceilings and ambiguous-send freezes, and sent stamped only by the observed provider event

Assistant history reaches the browser through service-only RPCs that return candidate ids and structured run evidence rather than raw tables or the service snapshot, and the Edge reauthorizes every fact and source before a title, date, question or answer is emitted

A supplier payment destination is structured rather than free text: the shape is Israeli or international and never both, the browser reaches the table through no privilege of its own, the shared directory renders a country and a last four and nothing more, the legacy text waits in a private queue that only a human save closes, and the bank import refuses anything but the canonical workbook

An approved credit note becomes one received credit only when its invoice is unambiguous, a credit is consumed to its remainder and never against another invoice, an unlinked credit fails closed by name, and no financial reader answers from lifecycle labels

One-time owner reversal releases consumed quantity without touching evidence, audit rows carry a deterministic legal entity or fail closed, raw history is immutable outside a declared purge, and supplier metrics read 90 days

Product names are repaired only from the checksum-bound original submission: a wrong checksum mints no preview, a requester without authority is refused, a target missing from the source stays blocked, one approval renames one product with actor, reason and source row, and the same command retried is idempotent

Historical document kinds resolve through one visible precedence -- human, verified interpretation, existing non-other kind, allowlisted entity inference, then other -- where the interpretation map is an allowlist that can never propose a kind the live documents CHECK cannot store, and every applied decision carries its source in an append-only ledger

HEIC derivative provenance is immutable and server-written with source hash, dimensions and decoder version, decompression and pixel ceilings are structural rather than advisory, and full_frame_fallback is an explicit third scan source instead of an inference from coordinates

Owner calibration and Platform activation under step-up and completeness, a qualified-product dry-run that counts without writing, and the #245/#251/#252 negative guards proven by falsification to fire on a real violation rather than merely to return no rows

The launch ladder is ordered, priced in two versioned pre-tax catalogues and never lets a caller name its own currency; Legacy retires through an idempotent, audited, reasoned command whose dry run names every organization the new ceilings drop beneath; the usage period is anchored to the organization's signup instant, so no payment, renewal, tier change, cancellation, delinquency, late payment or refund resets a counter; and a referral pays both sides once, in their own periods, with only the unused remainder ever reversible

A provider event is recorded before anything acts on it and applied exactly once: a forged organization in the payload moves no entitlement, an unrecognized or undecided event type dead-letters without touching a plan, a merchant of record that is not enabled refuses even a correctly signed activation, no transition writes a usage counter or period, and a tenant reads none of the platform reconciliation surface

Who may START a payment, and what the server chooses for them: a checkout is refused while no merchant of record is enabled so nobody can pay for an entitlement the platform would refuse to grant, only an owner may buy, free and business and a misspelled rung all refuse identically so the catalogue cannot be enumerated from the differences, the price sold is the same mapped row that grants the rung on the way back, the provider-customer link is idempotent and can be neither re-pointed nor claimed by a second organization, and authorizing a purchase moves no plan

The signed Resend delivery ledger de-duplicates events in the database rather than in the handler, keeps the channel monotonic so a late callback cannot regress it, records delivery_failed without touching the order's own status, bounds the reason code in the schema itself, and mints a new portal link on retry while killing the previous one immediately

The WhatsApp ledger stops assuming one vendor: identity is checked per provider, message uniqueness is provider-scoped, webhook de-duplication is enforced by the database, status stays monotonic against a late callback, and inbound is refused by name

The plan ladder is monotonic and enforced: Free gets the Basic capability set for the existing 30-day clock then falls back, automatic interpretation spends its own quota once, user and branch limits refuse at the write, protected Data API paths fail closed, and both display catalogues remain separate from the verified billing currency

The plan refuses on the server: an owner on free cannot read or write the bank tables their tenant holds, the same owner on pro can, an unmeasured plan refuses nothing, a live override reopens and an expired one does not, and users.max counts an outstanding invitation as a seat already spent

Four-source document assessment: baseline as of the document date, draft receipts are not arrivals, absence from a partial document is not a shortage, and assessing writes nothing
The review screen's single door to the private resolvers: role boundary, unit scope inside a definer body, and file-stored versus data-approved kept apart

Applying an approved document: the server recomputes the assessment rather than trusting the proposal, an invoice never receives goods, a delivery note only drafts, and a tax receipt creates no payable
Multi-currency intake: ISO currency is evidence, manual invoices require it, minor units are enforced, and duplicate/order checks stay inside one currency
Multi-currency payments: requests and credits stay in one currency, bank rows match settlement money, direct cross-currency matching is refused, and no FX rate is stored
currencies_in_use() answers the history of currencies rather than the open balance, stays inside one tenant through RLS rather than through a definer, and returns nothing to a retired role
Intake reports an amount check it could not run instead of skipping it in silence, keeps the document unblocked while it warns, and leaves a shekel business with exactly the findings it had before

The invoice stops judging every currency by a shekel: a yen discrepancy inside 100 is not reported and one outside it is, half a dinar is five times the dinar tolerance and no longer slips through, a shekel business sees exactly what it saw before, a stated per-currency tolerance beats the derived one, an unresolvable tolerance warns without blocking, and the vat-rate tolerance is not money and did not move

The launch window moved and every copy of the old date moved with it: the function is still the only literal, no subscription flag row or autonomy policy is left on the old date, the targeting JSONB survived being edited, a hand-dated grant and a paying organisation are both excluded by the same predicate that moved the rest, and every moved row is in the ledger with the ruling behind it and both sides of the change

A document that never arrived can finally be expected: one active series per supplier and type is enforced for organisation-wide rows too where an ordinary unique would have enforced nothing, an occurrence keeps both what happened and what was done so a late arrival does not erase having been missed, an expectation is born proposed and stated and the command cannot ask for otherwise, every cross-table reference is scoped so a row cannot reach another tenant, and the exception vocabulary can name the finding

A document that never arrived is finally noticed: a proposal nobody approved and an expectation switched on today are not made responsible for a month that already ended, a period still inside its window and grace is not reported, the exception is opened once and audited with a reason and no operator, running the scan again changes nothing, not-this-month closes one month without touching the next, and a document that turns up late does not erase having been late

Two overlapping scans do not queue: the second returns in milliseconds instead of waiting out the first, which is what keeps a nightly run inside its window -- and the ledger still agrees with itself on exceptions, audit rows and the occurrence they belong to

A supplier logo path is a security boundary and is tried rather than described: another tenants folder, another suppliers folder inside the same tenant, a bare filename, a traversal and an svg are all refused, a path and its timestamp cannot exist without each other, the browser may read the columns but never write them, and the setter is reachable by no client role

The document assessment says BY HOW MUCH it does not add up and which rung it never read: the gap is real arithmetic rounded by the assessment own minor units, it keeps its sign, it is null rather than zero where a rung is missing, the missing rungs are named, discounts are summed, and nothing that decides anything moved

The invoice publishes the same ladder the document does and it agrees with the decision: the gap is the number the block was made on and keeps the document sign while the existing difference_amount keeps its opposite one, an invoice nobody itemised names the missing rung instead of reporting a zero discount, the yen ladder carries no decimals, and the three line totals two Edge tools read did not move

One definition of the thirty-day introduction and one server clock: the extracted window agrees with the entitlement ladder about who is in an introduction, a granted premium tenant has no introduction to lose so its boundary is the grant, an expired window is null rather than zero, a paying customer is not eligible, the payload carries plan keys and never a Hebrew label, and the private helper is unreachable by a client role
One definition per money question: the business day rather than the UTC day, snapshot prices, approved invoices only, and only credits that actually reduced a balance
One delivery counted once: the order item is the de-duplication grain, a completed receipt beats a supplier bill, and products are never merged by name
A supplier preference breaks a tie and never wins one: price orders first, both recommendation sites carry the rule, and setting it takes a reason
Document removal states what it destroys before it destroys it: an approved, paid or reported record blocks the destructive option, and every refusal names itself
One overcharge, one draft credit request: a retry drafts nothing, being undercharged drafts nothing, and the price list is never touched
The accountants own workbook becomes the export: the document contract validator is untouched, an approved report template has a file, and an approved file is never swapped
Retired kitchen, payer and supplier identities preserve history but cannot be invited, activated or restored as product accounts
Browser Storage inserts work with service-populated fields absent while tenant paths and the three active product roles remain enforced

P77 the assistant quota stops refusing everybody: 50 runs inside an immutable 30-day introduction anchored to the owner's first email verification, the plan figures #198 decided after it, a contract-priced rung that still refuses until an override exists, no reset from a tier change or the Legacy cutover, and two concurrent runs at limit-minus-one serialising to exactly one; plus the two read models the assistant explains but never computes -- calendar-month supplier price rises carrying baseline, source and as-of where an unmeasurable row is excluded rather than zeroed, and a purchase comparison that returns supplier-minimum breaches instead of raising a quantity

P85 cross-tenant user administration and the operator roster's write path: the directory is readable only under user.view and is no oracle for platform authority, a change demands the capability, a reason and a fresh password, the supplier role and the last active owner are both refused, both audit trails are written and a no-op writes neither, the profiles guard still refuses a direct write once the command's handshake closes, and nobody may change their own authority

P86 the controlled purge on a tenant that actually used the product: the declared teardown window opens for every BEFORE DELETE guard on a tenant table except the purge ledger which is meant to outlive it, three-way evidence and external egress evidence no longer halt the shared teardown, UPDATE stays refused inside the same declared purge, the residue tables that carry no org_id are swept before the staged delete, and a tenant is not recorded as purged while objects survive under its storage prefix

The control centre compares periods in one place: the month-to-date baseline ends on the same day number and is clamped to the length of the previous month so July 31 meets June 30 and March 31 meets February 28, the invoiced comparison stays whole month against whole month, each currency carries its own pair with a measured zero where it did not trade and no row where it never traded, drafts and soft-deleted invoices stay out, and a role that may not read the dashboard gets nothing

An invoice can carry the date it is due and nothing invents one: a supplier stating net-60 terms still leaves the invoice undated because nobody parses that free text, a direct update is refused so the audited command is the only door, the command is owner and office only and idempotent and never writes a reasonless audit row, clearing the date is an answer rather than a deletion, a date ten years from its invoice is refused, and the definer function is pinned to the scope ledger

Scheduled payments are reported with the coverage they have and never as a forecast: the horizon figure is dated active in-window money only, coverage comes back in rows AND in money on a fixture where the two ratios disagree, each currency keeps its own row, undated order commitments sit beside the horizon and never inside it, office is refused in words instead of with zeros while the accountant is answered, and the monthly writer freezes a cohort that refuses every later update and delete

Saying yes to a conversation is recorded once per window and logged once per recording: two presses leave one row and one ledger entry, the window is derived on the server and matches my_plan_grant so the grant is not defined twice, an organisation that has paid and a caller who is not the owner are both refused by name, the plan and the billing periods are untouched, and my_benefit_window refuses a non-owner in words instead of answering with an empty object

The benefit strip can report three things and no more, and cannot widen its own ceiling: a thousand repeats leave one row because the idempotency key is derived from tenant event window and day, an unknown event name and an unknown property key are both refused by name rather than dropped, a long or non-string property value is refused, the organisation comes from auth_org and never the payload, an office user and an owner with no window are both refused, and the two server-observed facts are not defined as client events

A document nobody uploaded, and every way it must not become one: the actor rule holds in BOTH directions on all three tables so a browser upload with no uploader is refused alongside an email document that names one, a job cannot claim a different source than its document because the composite key makes the mismatch unstorable, an image with no human finally reaches the scan queue that 0136 closed to it, and the ingest command -- called by service_role, which reads every tenant -- refuses another tenant's object, a stale lease token, an object whose version moved under it and a closed channel, while a replay returns the same document rather than a second one; plus a sibling legal entity that cannot see the other's post, a platform boundary no product role including service_role can write, and a claimer that stopped requiring a human without losing the active owner/office requirement it had for browser uploads

A WhatsApp number that can receive a document, and the four ways it must not: the prefixed spelling of a number that already has a row is refused by shape so one number cannot become two identities and a lookup cannot miss a tenant that exists, while a meta_cloud connection keeps using an id rather than a phone number; receiving is refused without a route because an inbound document has no uploader and would otherwise be org-wide across sibling legal entities; a whatsapp connection cannot borrow an email route and inherit its legal entity; and with the tenant's connection active, its route live and its flag on, the door STAYS SHUT until the platform boundary opens it -- each tenant-side condition then closing it again one at a time. Plus the intake size limit reading the bucket rather than copying it, a dead-letter reason drawn from a closed list instead of a typed sentence, and the provider-side media deletion #317 promises proved to be a retried row that cannot claim success without evidence

The welcome email a paid activation owes is owed exactly once: the first verified activation records a debt addressed to the owner resolved from our own tables while a payload that names its own recipient changes nothing, a redelivered or resumed activation records no second row across a window longer than any provider idempotency header, a claim leases the row so a concurrent sender finds nothing, a replayed settlement is a no-op rather than a second send, an organization whose welcome already went out never becomes claimable again, an organization with no active owner records no debt and still receives the plan it paid for, and no tenant role can run either command

A platform operator carries the capability it was declared to need, and the five commands that never asked for one: an analyst whose four capabilities are all reads and an operator holding no role at all are both refused BY NAME on suspension, on a feature flag and on all three policy writers -- and the refusal leaves neither a configuration row nor an audit row, so it is a refusal and not a rollback; the operator who does hold the capability still suspends, reactivates and configures with the values landing, the lifecycle step-up is untouched by the new guard, every by-name refusal those four commands already made still fires under its own name, and no platform writer of that shape escapes the capability list

An abandoned self-signup is released in a day and its identity goes with it: the window is a named function reading the 24 hours #332 left as a documented default rather than a literal nobody can find, an empty unconfirmed organization past it loses its tenant rows AND the auth.users row that would otherwise hold the address hostage in GoTrue for ever, an organization still inside the window is refused by name, a confirmed owner and a single supplier row each still stop the delete without taking the identity with them, a platform operator who also opened a trial keeps the console account a retention job must never remove, the retained record counts the identities it released and still carries no PII, and neither browser role nor a non-service caller can reach any of it

Every tenant counts its own documents from 1: on all six numbered tables a brand-new organization is numbered 1 however busy the tenant beside it is -- the cross-tenant activity signal a global identity sequence published every time somebody read their own numbers -- while an existing tenant continues from its OWN maximum and never reuses a number it has already issued, including one whose row was deleted, because the counter records what was handed out rather than what survived; an explicit number is refused BY NAME rather than honoured, since the identity it replaces refused one at the storage layer; and the structure that makes all of it checkable holds -- unique (org_id, number) on all six, the global identity and its sequence really gone rather than merely unused, the counter table granted to no client role, and the allocator still SECURITY INVOKER so no A5 definer exemption is spent on allocating an integer

A failed signup leaves nothing behind, and a real tenant survives the same door: the compensation for a two-minute-old organization whose only member is the profile the attempt itself created removes every row on every public table carrying an org_id rather than a hand-picked list, each of the three fences -- past the window, a member nobody named, one supplier row of real business -- refuses BY NAME and changes nothing, the named profile is still standing after a refusal because the deletion happens inside the transaction and after the fences rather than from the Edge function beforehand, naming another tenant's profile excuses nobody, a second rollback reports the organization absent instead of raising so a partial compensation can be retried, and the door itself holds: no browser role, a non-service caller refused by name, no one-argument overload, and no DEFAULT on the second parameter -- which to_regprocedure cannot see and pronargdefaults can

A password change is the holder's own record: the accountant who is the subject of none of them stops reading the owner's and a colleague's password_changed rows while still reading their OWN, the owner -- the only role with an audit surface -- still reads every one of its tenant's, the same narrowing holds in a second tenant and across the boundary between them, and the row set the accountant loses is EXACTLY the two rows named rather than any part of the identity or financial ledger beside them; every read issued as authenticated with that person's own subject, because a read as postgres skips RLS and proves nothing

One balance, one approval: an invoice of 640 already holding 300 approved refuses a second approval of the whole balance BY NAME while still ALLOWING the second request to be typed, splitting a payment across two approvals of 250 and 390 still passes, two sessions approving on the same locked invoice leave exactly one winner and one named refusal, and the writer that could not see a partially consumed credit stops admitting 900 where the reader prints 780 -- every refusal measured as an authenticated owner rather than as the superuser, so the financial guard and the role checks are actually in the path

A currency this role cannot value gets no row rather than a zero: the accountant sees the shekel debt it may value and NOTHING at all where the supplier owes 300 dollars on an unapproved invoice, so the card draws an em dash instead of the sentence that supplier owes nothing here, a supplier it can value nothing of returns nothing at all, a currency it CAN value is still reported in full, a measured zero that was paid off stays a zero rather than becoming an em dash, the owner's six rows are byte-for-byte what they were, and 150 shekels and 300 dollars are never one row of 450 -- every reading taken as an authenticated owner and an authenticated accountant rather than as the superuser, so RLS, the view grants and the role arms are actually in the path

A price the reader can say, and a sum that admits when it was never measured: a unit price printed the way a Hebrew invoice prints it reaches the review grid as 4.20 instead of an em dash, the three lines carrying it are summed to 969.00 with the coverage counted rather than left at a fabricated 0.00, and the header-versus-lines block that fired against that fabrication is gone; a line whose price is genuinely ABSENT makes the sum null with `lines_net` named in missing_rungs, a per-line finding naming the missing price and a document finding saying the sum was not measured -- never a partial sum compared against a whole header; a price printed in another currency is refused BY NAME rather than falling silent; and the filing refusal names the date it could not read instead of announcing that an invoice number displayed at confidence 0.95 is missing -- every assessment read as an authenticated office clerk through the definer read, and the filing ladder reached in the trusted no-JWT shape the Edge Function uses, because the command grants EXECUTE to service_role and not to authenticated

The /settings boundary is the database's and not the router's: no client role can select a colleague's phone or backup address off profiles, nor the tenant's commercial columns off organizations, while every other column of both stays readable and a person keeps the UPDATE on their own two; the owner reads all four narrowed surfaces through a directory that is not security_invoker, keeps security_barrier and carries both its role and its tenant predicate, office and accountant read NOTHING from any of them, a second tenant's owner reads only their own, and the direct column path is refused for the owner too -- every read measured as an authenticated subject rather than as the superuser, aggregated per row and compared to a literal, never counted

A statement line is spent once: a 2,950 line already holding its whole amount in confirmed allocations refuses a second full match BY NAME through match_bank_transaction called as an authenticated owner, the table refuses the same second allocation whatever wrote it, one shekel past a legal 1,000 + 1,950 split is refused while the split itself stands, an allocation MOVED from another line onto a full one is refused where the same move onto a line with room is accepted, two sessions racing 2,000 and 2,000 at that line leave exactly one winner and one named refusal while two racing 1,000 and 1,000 both stand, and a full-amount SUGGESTION beside a confirmed match is not an over-allocation because a suggestion claims no money
